falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically showed shallow, V-shaped recoveries with limited follow-through selling after initial lows; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural support expected in that pattern and indicate genuine distribution rather than a tradable bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 suggests elevated but contained fear; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation beyond the pattern's typical fear peak (~28-32), invalidating the controlled capitulation thesis and signaling a deeper liquidation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts more than -50 basis points (i.e., -0.50% or wider)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug occurred with a stabilizing curve; a sharp re-inversion to -50bps or beyond would signal recession repricing and credit stress that the pattern did not embed, breaking the macro assumption underlying the 81% match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
